extracted.intended_audience: researchers/academics preparing and submitting papers to arXiv (authors)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for preparing and submitting a paper (text and figures) to the arXiv e-print archive, including accepted file formats, figure formats, submission procedures, replacement policy, and availability schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv accepts submissions only from registered authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submitters must be registered on arXiv before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness of submission (no omitted material or abstract-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions must not omit figures, tables, or sections and arXiv does not accept 'abstract only' submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Omitted material or abstract-only uploads are unhelpful to readers and of very limited archival value; include complete content in the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission route
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the arXiv Submit form to upload a paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Submit form workflow; procedural requirement rather than emailing files to admin address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted text formats (order of preference)
rubrics_metrics.description: Text submissions must be in one of the listed formats, in order of preference: (La)TeX, AMS(La)TeX, PDFLaTeX; PDF; PostScript; HTML with JPEG/PNG/GIF images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The goal is to store papers in portable, stable formats; TeX/LaTeX is preferred because it does not hide information. Users of word processors should save documents as PDF and submit that. Scanned documents are not accepted in any format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on certain TeX-related outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv will not accept dvi, PS, or PDF created from TeX/LaTeX source (for stated reasons).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit DVI, certain PS, or PDFs that are simply compiled outputs from TeX/LaTeX if that conflicts with arXiv guidance; prefer providing TeX/LaTeX source or accepted formats listed above.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figure file formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Figures may be submitted as PostScript (PS/EPS) for line drawings/plots, JPEG for photographic images, GIF or PNG for non-photographic bitmaps, and PDF figures only if using PDFLaTeX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the format that best matches the figure type (e.g., EPS for plots, JPEG for photos). PDF figures are only supported when the submission is built with PDFLaTeX.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not omit figures by linking externally
rubrics_metrics.description: If figure files are too large, reduce them but include them in the submission; arXiv does not accept submissions where figures are omitted and provided via links to other servers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the network constraints of readers (e.g., users with poor connections). Reduce figure size where possible; consult arXiv information on submission sizes and bitmapping help for techniques. Contact www-admin@arXiv.org if you have problems with large submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use standard LaTeX graphics packages when including figures in source
rubrics_metrics.description: If you submit figures together with (La)TeX source, use standard macro packages (e.g., graphics and graphicx) so figures will appear correctly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using standard, widely-available packages increases the chance arXiv's processing will render figures properly.

rubrics_metrics.name: No TeX support from arXiv administration
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv administration cannot provide help with TeX-related issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek assistance from colleagues or local TeX experts rather than expecting arXiv staff to fix TeX problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read arXiv response and check submission
rubrics_metrics.description: After submission you will receive a response; authors must read that response and check the copy of the abstract and the generated PostScript for errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The response will include a URL to view the PostScript version and credentials for viewing it. If you see formatting or content errors, take corrective action (see replacement policy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement policy (how to correct a submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should replace the original submission to correct formatting/problems or to post errata; do not make a new submission for a corrected paper or an erratum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you replace before 16:00 US Eastern time (Monday–Friday), the archive software will not generate an additional date stamp. Replacing is encouraged rather than resubmitting a new entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: If unable to correct yourself, contact admin (no files in email)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot correct problems yourself, email www-admin@arXiv.org explaining the problem before 16:00 US Eastern time, including the archive and paper number, but do not send files/submissions to this address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use email only for explanation; don't attach submission files to admin email.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author responsibility for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors must make their own submissions; third-party submissions (e.g., by secretaries) are discouraged and often cause problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Putting authors in charge reduces errors and accountability issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide institutional affiliation and official report numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission must include institutional affiliation for the author(s) and official report number(s) from the author(s)' institutions, if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These metadata are required information fields during submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability schedule and daily release times
rubrics_metrics.description: Archives operate on a daily availability schedule with no activity on weekends; new submissions become publicly available after 20:00 US Eastern time (EDT/EST) Sunday through Thursday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: a Monday submission before 16:00 appears after 20:00 that day; a Friday submission before 16:00 appears after 20:00 the following Sunday; a Friday submission after 16:00 appears after 20:00 the following Monday. Check current local time at main site for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public availability of official versions
rubrics_metrics.description: All official versions of submitted papers are made publicly available; submission version availability is governed by arXiv policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that versions you submit (and replacements) will be accessible publicly according to arXiv's versioning and availability rules.
